test_title: PYST 14: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Choose the address that is exactly the same as the one provided below.

12/B, Riverside Estate, Marine Drive, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400021

options.text: 12/B, Riverside Estates, Marine Drive, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400021
12/B, Riverside Estate, Marine Drive, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400021
12/B, Riverside Estate, Marine Drive, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400012
21/B, Riverside Estate, Marine Drive, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400021

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Address: 12/B, Riverside Estate, Marine Drive, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400021

Now, checking the given options:

Option 1) 12/B, Riverside Estates, Marine Drive, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400021 → extra **“s”**

Option 2) **12/B, Riverside Estate, Marine Drive, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400021 **→ **Exactly the same** (wording, order, and PIN all match)

Option 3) 12/B, Riverside Estate, Marine Drive, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400012 → **PIN code differs** (400012 instead of 400021)

Option 4) 21/B, Riverside Estate, Marine Drive, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400021 → **House number differs** (21/B instead of 12/B)

Thus, 12/B, Riverside Estate, Marine Drive, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400021 matches the address.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 2'.**
